caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or fabric with slightly curved edges, shown laid flat against a light, neutral background. The main area of the fabric is a soft beige or off-white color. The surface is decorated with an array of small, detailed floral motifs in a repeating pattern, predominantly in shades of blue with occasional brown and muted red accents. The border features a prominent wavy line, which loops around the edges and encloses a dense arrangement of flowers and leaves primarily in blue, with some flowers colored in brown and a few triangular clusters of small red dots. The interior of the fabric contains smaller, more loosely spaced floral clusters, mostly in blue with some brown centers. The composition presents the floral motifs symmetrically across the surface, with the border design framing the more sparsely decorated center.
title: Embroidered Blanket
